title: Special tour!
text:
Egor was a great guide, we saw all the sites and learned about the history of this great city! 

We had a personalized tour as it’s the off season and the weather was perfect. He showed us all the secrets of the gothic quarter and shared historic and local lore. Well worth it.

title: Spectacular!
text: We went February 15 at 10:15 in the morning. The tour was spectacular! Our guide was very friendly and showed us the nice things about the city and knew many stories. We only had 2 days in Barça, but thanks to this tour we seem to have seen a lot. I recommend this tour!
